exitCodes.0: ok (merges may be an empty list)
exitCodes.2: usage error or not a module-crew project

firstStage.notes: read only. merges: local merges into the integration branch not yet in any `merge push` record, in merge order; auto=true when released by `merge auto` after Codex found no blocking issue in the final patch (release carries the report path, reportSha256, delegate scope.fingerprint, rounds, suggestions), auto=false for the user's own approvals. check is the check-ledger entry of the merge tree's full check (nonAuthor: a full check that passed, not inherited, not run by the module's own session). repo is owner/name parsed from the configured remote; baseBranch follows `merge push-plan`'s PR-base rule; pushedUpTo is informative only. module-crew never writes autopilot evidence or spec-guard's acceptance record.
